description: Fork of exp603 (LUT-LM SoTA 1.4295 @ 289M). SINGLE change: backward_mode 'soft' -> 'hybrid_smooth' for ALL 4 LUT modules (qk_lut, v_lut, out_proj, read_out_lut). New mode just added to TinyMultiHeadLut: forward = smooth blend of main row + Hamming-1 alternative at least-confident anchor pair (u = 0.5/(1+|d_min|/T), main_weight = 1-u, alt_weight = u). Backward: SOFT input/temp gradients (full K-row softmax, same as backward_mode='soft'); WEIGHT gradient scattered ONLY to main and alt rows scaled by (1-u, u) — matches forward semantics. Tests whether the smooth forward + soft input grad combination beats both pure-soft (exp603) and standard MHLut(smooth) at exp603 architecture. Reference: exp386 showed MHLut(smooth, n_alt=3) beat TinyMHLut(soft) by 5 millibits at tiny scale; this is the cleaner version (n_alt=1, soft input grad). bs=16 unchanged.
